page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration. The lack of local NVMe storage represents a tradeoff, requiring reliance on network-attached volumes for persistent data.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r8i.6xlarge offers high memory density per dedicated vCPU, making it suitable for memory-intensive workloads without the overhead of paying for local storage or GPU accelerators. Appropriate workloads for this profile include in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and large-scale data processing tasks that require substantial memory capacity but moderate compute resources.
